pairs.why: The wagons are nearly identical, but B has no cartoon sun and has calmer, smoother grass, which is closer to the cleaner, less busy real backgrounds.
This is the same pair with the sides swapped: A has no sun and fewer grass details, so it reads closer to the uncluttered real cards.
B's firelight warms the cauldron rim and the stones, like the warm light on the real cards, while A's fire barely lights anything around it, so it looks flatter.
This is the same pair with the sides swapped: A has the firelight on the pot and stones, so it sits in its lighting the way the real cards do.
